RecoveryClosure.atomicity: Restore start, SDK completion, final closure/permission projection and next prompt are separate transitions. Current Notion edits and observed denial may interleave before projection. An epoch change cancels this operation; it cannot publish old bytes. A failed fixed read becomes a local capability warning, not a persistent prompt abort.
